# @elata-biosciences/biosignal-session

Local-first biosignal session recording: contracts + MessagePort wire
protocol + Arrow IPC chunk encoding. Raw data is local-only by default.

Model: Session -> Source -> Stream -> Chunk -> Event.
Time: session-relative integer microseconds; anchor = (Date.now(),
performance.now()) captured on the client UI thread at session create.
Regular streams carry no per-sample time column — time derives from
sampleIndexStart + sampleRateHz; gaps are explicit DiscontinuityV1 records.

Entries:
- "." (DOM-free): contracts (BiosignalSessionV1, SourceDescriptorV1,
  StreamDescriptorV1, ChunkDescriptorV1, SessionEventV1,
  ClockAlignmentObservationV1), protocol (BIOSIGNAL_PROTOCOL_VERSION=1,
  init kind "__elata_biosignal_init", ClientToHost/HostToClient unions,
  BiosignalErrorCode, BIOSIGNAL_LIMITS), crc32c/crc32cHex/checksumOf,
  createSessionClock/captureClockAnchor/sampleTimeUs.
- "./browser": BiosignalSource/SourceSink/StreamHandle adapter contracts,
  Arrow schema builders (regular-wide-f32@1, battery@1, rppg-trace@1,
  rppg-metrics@1, ppg-metrics@1), encodeWideF32Chunk/encodeRowsChunk,
  decodeChunk/readFloat32Column/readTimeUsColumn,
  readOptionalColumn/diffChunkColumns/readRowsAgainstSchema (schema drift:
  columns a chunk predates read null, columns it gained are left in place).
- "./testing": mulberry32, gaussian, createFakeClock.

Key invariants: host assigns identities (never the app); ACK = durable local
commit; idempotency key (sessionId, streamId, sequence) + crc32c; duplicate
with equal checksum replays ok, different checksum = sequence_conflict;
chunk payloads are complete Arrow IPC files, independently decodable, with
schema metadata keys elata:sessionId / elata:streamId / elata:arrowSchemaId.
